## Checklist

- [ ] I only edited `data/manufacturers.csv` (plus the regenerated `data/manufacturers.json` and `MANUFACTURERS.md`), or this is a code change.
- [ ] Every new or changed fact is stated on a public page linked above or in the `sources` column.
- [ ] Facts the manufacturer does not publish are left empty, not estimated.
- [ ] No descriptions, marketing copy, logos, or personal names, emails or phone numbers.
- [ ] `listing_url` is left empty for new manufacturers (maintainers fill it in).
- [ ] `npm run build && npm run validate` passes, or I've noted that I couldn't run it.
- [ ] The manufacturer meets the [listing criteria](https://plushsource.com/about/criteria).
- [ ] I agree that data contributions are published under CC BY 4.0.
